concerns.text: Task T006 (`code/data/acquisition.py`) performs the Data Availability Check and fetches real diffusion data, but the reusable streaming loader that implements this check is defined later as Task T062. Since T006 consumes the functionality provided by T062, the producer (T062) must precede the consumer (T006) to satisfy the data‑flow ordering. Move T062 (streaming loader) before T006 or adjust T006 to not depend on T062.
